# Morgan

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)</sub>
- **Role:** author  <sub>[v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P16](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0016), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P4](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0004), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P18](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0018)</sub>

## Appearance

Morgan is a short, stout lady. She has gray hair and wears a tweed suit.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Morgan is a delightful conversationalist and an excellent storyteller who has traveled extensively. Beneath her brilliant and sparkling demeanor, she possesses a deep, kindhearted sympathy that readily wins the affection of others.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)_

## Traits

- womanly sympathy and kindheartedness  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)</sub>

## History

Mrs. Morgan was a famous author who had traveled extensively and possessed a talent for storytelling. Though her initial visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) was canceled due to a sprained ankle, she unexpectedly arrived at a later date accompanied by [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md).

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P10](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0010), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P57](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0057), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P23](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0023), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

[Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) is a comrade who travels with Morgan on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island). She is also the niece of Mrs. Charlotte E. Morgan. [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) brought Mrs. Morgan to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) unexpectedly, where they were successfully hosted by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), +5 more_
